scope: Fresh native ready-primary owned-PC single-reagent consumption for ordinary and loop casts; durable inventory, core resources and cooldowns before original client acknowledgments.

source_authority.contract: UseSkillItem calls DeleteSkillItem for wItemID. With no weapon mask, scan ordered bag and slot maps, consume one first matching item, then send MOVEITEM success.
UseItem decrements count; sends UPDATEITEM for a remaining stack, DELITEM for its last element.
MOVEITEM one result BYTE; UPDATEITEM bag BYTE then original item descriptor; DELITEM bag BYTE and slot BYTE.
Ordinary SkillUse arms own/shared timers before item failure; loop checks item before arming. Rejected missing reagent returns UNSUITWEAPON=9 without HP/MP costs.
Equipment inventory 254 and default inventory 255, both unsigned BYTE.

implementation.eligibility: Pinned wItemID != 0 and dwWeaponID == 0; exact learned skill and owned fresh PC. Earliest unsigned bag/slot match. No equipped-item consumption, no full transferred graph, no nonzero authority epoch.
implementation.transaction: Migration 022 adds a full-row item fingerprint and append-only consumption receipts. One transaction validates process/account/claim/generation/epoch, catalog releases, ready contract-3 checkpoint, learned skill and source requirement. Lock exact owner/storage/slot/id/template/count and compare full-row hash; decrement/delete, core, timers and receipt commit together.
implementation.publication: Plan privately under character freeze with scratch timers. Publish only after confirmed COMMIT, preserving original timer clock origin. Private UPDATEITEM/DELITEM then MOVEITEM precede cast success and charged HPMP. No client packet fields added.
implementation.checkpoint_order: A checkpoint operation lease starts only without active gameplay; gameplay waits for an active checkpoint rather than dropping requests. Consumption holds gameplay operation through commit/publication. Separate consumption ledger leaves periodic revision unchanged.
implementation.uncertain_commit: No automatic retry. Close client, retain reservation and mark snapshot persistence_uncertain so teardown cannot overwrite durable core/timers with an older plan. Replacement process uses the committed recovery receipt. Test double injects unknown outcome; actual PostgreSQL tests cover late-trigger rollback and committed recovery.
implementation.permissions: Map may update TITEMTABLE.bCount and delete its items through fenced service operations; it cannot change item templates, learned ranks or delete consumption receipts. Historical charts remain read-only.
implementation.deployment: Apply migrations through 022 and deploy/sql/map-runtime-grants.sql before these binaries. All previously applied migrations and both backups retain fingerprints. Next migration is 023.

limitations: Original client executable has not been run; packet peers are source-derived encrypted test clients.
Full inventory movement, rewards, currency, ammo/durability, cash exceptions and equipment mutation remain unported.
Transferred/full-graph characters and equipped reagent selection fail before mutation; this increment supports fresh contract-3 primary characters only.

Authoritative effects, trade/store state, combat powers/damage, action/cancellation and full target/AOI rules remain unfinished. Private planning uses the existing freeze mechanism; full concurrent combat semantics are not established.

PostgreSQL/network unknown COMMIT acknowledgment is modeled in runtime tests; native tests separately prove transactional rollback and recovery of confirmed commits. No exactly-once client request identifier exists in the original protocol.
